Joe Terry, who practices law in Houston, Texas, was selected to Super Lawyers for 2013 - 2026. This peer designation is awarded only to a select number of accomplished attorneys in each state. Prior to becoming an attorney, he studied at South Texas College of Law Houston. He graduated in 1999. After passing the bar exam, he was admitted to legal practice in 1999.
